note:
Header banner for /collections/fine-lines-wrinkles, REBUILT after a label fault.

THE FAULT. The version this replaces carried a label with the helix, 'Skingenetix', 'ACETYL HEXAPEPTIDE-8' and 'ANTI-WRINKLE SERUM' - all correctly spelled - and then stopped, leaving the bottom third of the glass blank with the accent rule running down past the type into nothing. Measured against the product's own 2026 artwork render, two elements were absent outright: 'PREMIUM FORMULA' and '10% ACETYL HEXAPEPTIDE-8 | 30ML'.

HOW IT PASSED REVIEW, which is the durable lesson. This file's previous note records the label being checked twice, at 100% and again at rendered size, and both checks passed - because both asked whether the lines PRESENT were spelled correctly. Neither asked whether the lines that should be there were there. Checking for last time's fault is not the same as checking the product is right. A label check now means counting the elements against the artwork, not just reading the ones that appear.

THE REPAIR. configs/banners/flw-bottle-text-fix.json, run across all four capable suppliers rather than back to the one that produced the fault. Eight candidates, all eight restored the full six-element label; Seedream's two garbled the fine line, consistent with its own J-pose attempt. Ranked on TWO axes, because a clean label is worthless if the repair restaged the shot: composition drift against the original measured 4.30 (nbp_pro_01), 4.40 (nbp_flash_01), 7.6-9.1 for the rest. Malcolm chose nbp_flash_01. Verified at 100%: all six elements present, correctly spelled, cleanly drawn.

EXTENDED RIGHT to 3750x848 (4.42:1), matching the banner it replaces. Her shoulder runs off the LEFT edge (mean 81.5, max 183.8 - lit skin), while the right edge is clean end to end at 26.1-33.3.

texture_box stops at x=1899 because her fingers reach x=1975 and the boxes one step wider read max 212 against this one's 36. Scatter rather than tile: the serums banner proved a box passing exactly this threshold test can still carry vertical structure that tiling turns into evenly spaced lens shapes. Residual banding 2.35 levels on a background of 28.7.

Clear ground for the heading, which sits RIGHT on this page: 257px at 1280, 417px at 1440, 897px at 1920.
